name: Tracking the Visual White Matter (TVWM) (Trekker) - Eccentricity
summary: Tracks visual white matter by seeding Trekker parallel transport tractography in the white matter and terminating in eccentricity-binned visual ROIs, and outputs a tractogram and a white matter classification.
description: For each eccentricity bin, seeds Trekker throughout the white-matter mask and keeps streamlines that reach the visual ROI for that bin (both ends if both_endpoints is true), discarding streamlines that enter CSF or the exclusion ROIs. Use it to map the white matter reaching visual cortex at different eccentricities. Needs DWI, CSD FODs, eccentricity-binned visual ROIs and a 5-tissue-type mask of the same subject; tracking with both_endpoints is considerably slower.

inputs.description: Preprocessed diffusion-weighted image with bvecs and bvals.
Constrained spherical deconvolution FODs (lmax2 to lmax14 files); the FOD at the chosen lmax is what Trekker tracks on.
inputs.requirements: Must contain the FOD file for the requested lmax (or every lmax when single_lmax is false).

inputs.description: Eccentricity-binned ROIs named <roi>.Ecc<min>to<max>.nii.gz (optionally with an ROI prefix), as generated by the eccentricity ROI App.
inputs.requirements: Must contain an ROI for every min_degree/max_degree bin; same grid as the DWI unless reslice is true.

inputs.description: 5-tissue-type segmentation in DWI space; its CSF is used to discard streamlines and its white matter as a mask.
Optional whole-brain mask; if absent a mask is computed from the DWI with MRtrix3 dwi2mask.

outputs.description: Tractogram (.tck) of all streamlines generated, merged across ROI pairs and ensemble settings.
Brain mask in DWI space used during tracking (the input mask or one computed with dwi2mask).
White matter classification (classification.mat) assigning streamlines to each tracked pathway, with surface meshes of the ROIs for the brainlife viewer.
Per-run tractograms and tckinfo text files kept as derivatives.

parameters.description: Minimum streamline length.
Maximum streamline length.
Spherical harmonic order of the FOD to track on (the maximum order when ensembling across lmax).
This is the exact name (following ROI prefix) of the visual ROI the user wants to use as the visual termination ROIs. The name comes from the ROI input directory. Example: 'varea'

this field is the exact ROI name or number from the ROI datatype for the exclusion ROIs. Example: 'exclusion_L'. If bother hemispheres are being tracked, enter the name separated by a space for each exclusion 'exclusion_R'. Please see ROI datatype for exact name of each.

These exclusion can be any grouping of ROIs that you DO NOT want streamlines to cross. For example, opposite hemisphere white matter, cerebellar white matter, hippocampus are good exclusions for the OR. 

If you do not want to use exclusion ROIs, leave blank
Number of streamlines (Trekker seed count) to generate per ROI pair and setting.
minimum radius of curvature. If left as 'default', trekker will automatically determine best curvature. Otherwise, enter value of radius of curvature (i.e 0.5)
step size. If left as 'default', trekker will automatically determine best step size. Otherwise, enter value of step size (i.e 0.5)
If true, track only on the FOD of the selected lmax; if false, run ensemble tracking across even lmax values up to lmax.
minimum FOD amplitude. If left as 'default', trekker will automatically determine best FOD amplitude. Otherwise, enter value of FOD amplitude (i.e 0.5)
Maximum sampling per seed for Trekker; 'default' lets Trekker choose.
Maximum seed trials for Trekker; 'default' lets Trekker choose.
Trekker probe count; 'default' lets Trekker choose.
Trekker probe length; 'default' lets Trekker choose.
Trekker probe radius; 'default' lets Trekker choose.
Trekker probe quality; 'default' lets Trekker choose.
Passed to Trekker useBestAtInit: start each streamline from the best initial direction.
If true, reslice the ROIs to the DWI grid with FreeSurfer mri_vol2vol (header-based) before tracking; set when ROIs do not match DWI dimensions.
Space-separated lower bounds of the eccentricity bins to track; each must match an ROI file name.
Space-separated upper bounds of the eccentricity bins, paired with min_degree.
If it is desired that both sets of endpoints end in the visual ROIs, set true. otherwise, set false. Note: tracking will take considerably longer if true

citations.text: Aydogan D.B., Shi Y. A novel fiber tracking algorithm using parallel transport frames. Proceedings of the 27th Annual Meeting of ISMRM (2019).

failure_modes.cause: No classification.mat was produced, usually because no streamlines were found.
failure_modes.fix: Check the ROI names, exclusions and tracking parameters, and the log.

failure_modes.cause: No FreeSurfer license in the environment.
failure_modes.fix: Set the FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable on the compute resource.
